name: usage-band
description: Usage band under the prompt: context usage coloured by category with each share, the 5h / 7d plan limits and the session cost.

position.title: Position / 位置
position.description: below: under the prompt (default); above: above the prompt

legend.title: Module: category legend / 模块：分类明细
legend.description: The categories filling the context (biggest first) with tokens and share, under the context bar.

legendLayout.title: Legend layout / 明细排列
legendLayout.description: grid: aligned columns folded into as few rows as fit (default); list: one category per row; inline: flowing, wrapping at the edge.

showLimits.title: Module: plan limits / 模块：额度
showLimits.description: 5h and 7d plan limits with reset time (Pro / Max).

showCost.title: Module: cost / 模块：花费
showCost.description: Session cost in US dollars at the right of the limits row: what /cost totals, estimated at API list price (not the bill; on a subscription, usage within the plan is not charged this).
